question: Ticket filing moves into skills/sorted/door.py: the sorted door files the ticket it berths, and the caster writes no ticket by hand and no filing script (today filing is a scratchpad script rewritten each voyage — file_tickets.py 2026-09-14, file_tickets2.py 2026-09-15, castlib.py 2026-09-16 — the measured gap). BUILD ORDER inside this one voyage: first the charter skills/sorted/intention+why.json gains the two contract fields decisions and intent_berth (that is D15's act, done before any line of door.py is edited); then file_ticket is written. The check that the two fields are present and non-empty is NOT new code: the standing seam cairn/machines/learning_block/learning_block.py:219 inspect_input already refuses any contract field that is absent or empty, so adding the fields to the charter IS the check — the only new judge in door.py is the by check on each line (D4). THE INPUT is the sorted packet, which after that charter change ALWAYS carries decisions (a list of lines) and intent_berth (the absolute path of the /intent berth) — both required, non-empty, refused by name when absent. THE FUNCTION is file_ticket(payload, berth, *, commons) in door.py, called from fire() after sb.fire returns and only when payload['exit'] == 'routed_forward' (a routed_out packet berths and files nothing): it reads from_idea and task_or_ticket out of the intent berth's answers; mints the id as secrets.token_hex(6), redrawn while a file <hex>-* already stands in the tickets store; builds the v2 ticket from the packet's own fields — id, title, node_class, task_or_ticket, workflow_and_state (the packet's workflow), date and created (today), author ('CC via /sorted'), from_idea, intent_berth, sorted_berth (= result['berth'], the path sb.fire returned), owner (the packet's gates_bound owner if named, else 'CC'), owning_intention (the packet's owning_intention if present, else the title), questions (the packet's questions), falsifier (the packet's falsifier_check), watchme, depends_on ([]), follow_ons (the packet's children unless it is a 'none, because' string, then []), schema_version 'ticket-v2', rehearsal 'none-yet', decisions (the packet's list verbatim); writes <hex>-<title>.json under <commons>/tickets/ through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(path, json text, verb='cast', why='/sorted cast <hex> <title>: sorted berth <berth>') — 'cast' is the verb every ticket write already journals under; commons is the injected kwarg fire() already accepts (the proof's scratch commons) or, when None, the live commons the door's other judges default to (_COMMONS). THE OUTPUT: the dict fire() returns gains ticket_path (absolute) and ticket_id (the hex), and main() prints it as it prints the berth today — is that the decision?
